11.6.2
Translation from several sources
There is also the use-case to support the composition of data from different sources.
Because the sources will arrive in a not coordinated way, it is essential to define which
part of the source mapped data actually triggers the sending of the target payload.
[TPS_MANI_03584]{DRAFT} Definition of transmission triggers for translations
with different sources ⌈The attribute SignalBasedEventElementToISignal-
TriggeringMapping.transmissionTrigger respectively SignalBasedField-
ToISignalTriggeringMapping.transmissionTrigger defines which transla-
tion parts contribute to the transmission triggering for the mapped payload.⌋(RS_-
MANI_00063)
[TPS_MANI_03588]{DRAFT} Full translation before transmission triggering ⌈In
case there has been a transmission trigger caused by a source signal the signal-
service-translation shall process all other mapped source signals from the triggering
source context (signal group or IPdu) before actually sending out the target.⌋(RS_-
